facts.fact: The Information Regulator's gazette notice of 26 September 2025 acts under the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 and its section 112(2)(c).
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013

facts.fact: The Information Regulator, chaired by Adv. FDP Tlakula, issued the notice inviting comments on draft regulations under the Act.
